question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Accomodate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Accommodate."** • The word **"Accommodate" **means to provide lodging or to fit in with someone's wishes or needs. (एक विशेष संख्‍या में लोगों के कहीं बैठने या ठहरने की पर्याप्त सुविधा होना) • **Example**: *Each apartment can **accommodate**__ up to six people.* • It is often misspelt as **"Accomodate" **due to confusion with the double** "m"** and double **"c."** • The correct spelling can be remembered by breaking it down into **"accommodate"** and **"ate"**, with two** "m"s and two "c"s **in the first part. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Ambassador)** is correctly spelled and refers to a high-ranking diplomat. (राजदूत; विदेश में किसी देश का आधिकारिक प्रतिनिधि) • **Option 2 (Architecture) **is correctly spelled and refers to the design and construction of buildings. (भवन निर्माण का अध्ययन या विज्ञान; वास्‍तुकला, स्‍थापत्‍यकला) • **Option 3 (Awful)** is correctly spelled and means extremely bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा, अत्‍यधिक अरुचिकर) 34:T619, The correct answer is** 'accused in.'**
